card.title: Exactly as Planned
card.instruction: Treat every exposed flaw, failed step, and unexpected consequence as proof that the scheme is unfolding by design.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The escape-room attendant found our shortcut. Phase one is working.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You made me distract her so you could crawl through it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She was supposed to feel she'd caught us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's throwing us out. We haven't solved a single clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the fast exit I planned. Ask her to put our time on the leaderboard; solving clues was only our cover.

mechanism: A retroactively claims discovery and expulsion were intended stages of the escape-room scheme.
confusable: Unlike finding a new advantage after failure, A must insist the failed steps were designed from the outset.
comparison: A converts expulsion into a planned fast exit; the party scene claims surrendering control was the original goal.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
